Beneficiary Dashboard — Final Pass Built

8 Oct 2026. Every proposal you approved, built in code, plus a reworked P12 and a polish of the landing portal cards. Titles and labels from the live site are unchanged. Figma follows next.

Part 1 — Built

P12 · Year on Year Report as one cardBuilt

The three cards become one, chosen with the segmented control under the live page’s own scheme names. The live totals lead (28,865 Seats Sanctioned, ₹347 Cr Cumulative Disbursement — the yearly rows add up to them exactly). The years follow as a real table: each year reads across, its count and its fund side by side, each bar with its value; the latest year is in bold. A screen reader meets the table row by row.

P12 · PhoneBuilt

Each value sits over its bar, so the table fits the card: nothing scrolls sideways, no year label is cut off.

Landing portal cards polishedBuilt

e-Anudaan’s waffle becomes the two modes as bars with counts and shares, its fund a figure. Long labels drop the small capitals (Senior Citizens, NMBA’s e-Pledge). Figures in a two-column list share a baseline.

P3 · NMBA figuresBuilt

Lakh and crore, as on the landing page. Reach in one row — Total, then Women and Youth each with its share of the total as a bar — engagement in the next. The theme chips are gone: with two themes, both are on the screen.

P3 · NMBA map and listBuilt

The legend and the State/UT list in lakh and crore.

P4 · SMILE fundsBuilt

Unchanged for a citizen, deliberately: the share utilised is the sheet’s own Office (post-login) KPI, so it appears — as “81% of Total Fund Released” with its bar — only for a signed-in officer.

P4b · SMILE digital deliveryBuilt

Each percentage is a bar.

P2 · No red in the ringsBuilt

A three-part ring stays a ring; its slices take the quiet order, never red.

P2 · SHRESHTA’s two-part rings become split barsBuilt

The whole leads; each mode is a bar with its count and share. Labels are the register’s own (Mode-I, Mode-II).

P2 · Senior Citizens, RVYBuilt

Same treatment; the total reads 2.83 lakh, as the tile beside it does.

P5 · Elderline totalBuilt

2.99 lakh calls in total — the five kinds added together, matching the landing card.

P9 · DAPSC mandateBuilt

The table’s answer first: 5 of 10 meet their mandated allocation, counted from its own column. The subtitle in plain words; the proforma’s original is kept in the register beside it.

P10 · Department page summary cardsBuilt

The small trend lines go — the Year by Year Trends section below draws each in full — and each card keeps its latest-year figure. The cards come out level and shorter.

P6 · One date formBuilt

05 Oct 2026, 30 Sep 2026 — DD MMM YYYY on every dashboard date, as the source notes already printed them. The site footer is shared and was not touched.

P11 · Switched views fade inBuilt

Choosing a theme, a component or a segment fades the new view in over 150 ms — opacity only, nothing moves — and not at all for a reader who asks for reduced motion. Not shown in stills.
